test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘ORGANIZATION’ is written as ‘ORGANINOITAZ’, ‘MANAGEMENT’ is written as ‘MANAGTNEME’. How will ‘RESOURCE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the English alphabet series is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

1) 'ORGANIZATION' is written as 'ORGANINOITAZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eac4b251f8d9d68eb6cebf000bf7e3379512bc5f864973ea10ec8b450fab56bf.png] 

And,

2) 'MANAGEMENT' is written as 'MANAGTNEME'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca6904a401f18aa993d96a55faa50d0243e7176d2f563bc339d6361f60381caf.png] 

Similarly,

3) 'RESOURCE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9afb22e431db70dfc0a9e35f1b8ce090301084332f00e6aefdd1aa33b471948b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"RESOECRU".**
